issues.title: FSST batched decode + substring prefilter bundle (q13)
issues.hypothesis: q13 (~638ms, 2nd largest) spends its scan time decoding FSST o_comment strings one at a time and then evaluating NOT LIKE '%special%requests%'. Two prior measurements: FSST batched decode (one shared allocation, remaining-space bound, used only via DecompressVector) gave q13 -4..-7%; the substring prefilter over contiguous decoded runs (E0004) gave -7.7%. Each alone is under q13's ~14% noise bar. Combined they should be about -12..-15%.
issues.plan: 1) In src/storage/compression/fsst.cpp, in the scan/DecompressVector path, decode a whole vector's strings into one shared string-heap buffer, bounding writes by the remaining space instead of a per-string worst case. 2) Re-apply the E0004 approach in ColumnData::Filter / ColumnSegment::FilterSelection: for a contains/LIKE ExpressionFilter with a constant literal, search the literal over back-to-back decoded strings with memchr/memmem, and map each hit to its row. Keep the fallback for all other cases.
issues.expected_gain: q13 -12..-15%; small gains on other templates with LIKE over FSST columns (q09 p_name, q16 s_comment)
issues.generality: Any scan of FSST-compressed strings, and any substring filter on string columns.
issues.risk: Medium: string lifetime and heap ownership in the batched decode, and NULL/empty-string handling in the prefilter.

dispatch: OR-of-ranges scan filter as dense-mask ExpressionFilter
